name: Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries - Wolong, Mt Siguniang and Jiajin Mountains
description: In the mountains of southwest Sichuan, China, this chain of seven nature reserves and nine scenic parks shelters more than a third of the world's wild giant pandas. It is the largest unbroken stretch of panda habitat left, and it also holds the species' key breeding centre. Snow leopards, red pandas and thousands of plant species share the forested slopes.
